name: Should I hire a general contractor or manage the finish-out myself?
description: Hiring a general contractor ensures licensed trade coordination, code compliance, and streamlined inspections, preventing costly construction errors and delays.

mainEntity.name: Should I hire a general contractor or manage the finish-out myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hiring a general contractor is strongly recommended because an interior finish-out requires coordinating multiple licensed trades, managing precise inspection sequences, and adhering to residential building codes. While acting as your own owner-builder might seem cost-effective, trade scheduling mistakes or failed rough-in inspections can lead to expensive teardowns and extended delays. A general contractor oversees framing, plumbing, electrical, and HVAC teams, ensuring that structural loads, wall anchors, and fire-separation assemblies comply with municipal and county standards.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hiring a general contractor ensures licensed trade coordination, code compliance, and streamlined inspections, preventing costly construction errors and delays.
